input.alphabet: ASCII code values 0 through 127; whitespace separators are TAB through CR and SPACE

output.meaning: stable distinct substrings from whitespace splitting, joined with one ASCII space; the first empty substring is retained

source_semantics.split: Parameterless .NET String.Split uses Unicode whitespace separators and default StringSplitOptions.None; empty substrings are retained.
source_semantics.benchmark_domain: ASCII bytes only; ASCII whitespace 0x09..0x0D and 0x20 match .NET whitespace within this domain.
source_semantics.distinct: Case-sensitive exact word equality; retain the first occurrence of every word, including at most one empty word.
